findings.description: sessions.js calls reloadCurrentPage() after saving notes, but the function is not defined. Define it to call loadSessions() or loadMemberSessionsData depending on context.

When a user checks in, counts are recalculated, but if another user checks in elsewhere, the first user sees stale counts until manual refresh. Document this as a known limitation or implement a refresh timer/button.

MembershipController.cs was patched to read 'memberId' (lowercase) instead of 'MemberId', but this is outside Phase 2 & 3 scope. Verify the JWT actually contains 'memberId' claim to prevent ownership bypass.
ISO 8601 week calculation around January 1st may disagree with browser week picker. Code documents this as affecting <1% of cases, but consider replacing with date range picker if issues arise.

findings.issue: Client-side pagination disabled with week filter
findings.description: When a week filter is active, sessions.js fetches pageSize=10000 and client-filters, disabling server pagination. Acceptable for current dataset size, but will cause performance issues if sessions grow to thousands. Consider server-side week filtering.
apiFetch reads localStorage.getItem('gym_token'), but some auth code may use 'token'. Verify consistency across auth.js, sessions.js, checkins.js.
